artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan to restore and port exclusion and imposition theories to the current z3_shim/solver/models.* API.
Orchestrator handoff JSON with status planned and plan artifact reference.

memory_candidates.content: When restoring pre-solver-migration ModelChecker theories from git history (commit abb3bf7d^), the modular models.* package structure (models.semantic.SemanticDefaults, models.proposition.PropositionDefaults, models.structure.ModelDefaults, models.constraints.ModelConstraints) and syntactic/utils re-exports (Operator, OperatorCollection, ForAll, Exists) already exist at that commit. The only genuine API gap to port is the solver abstraction: replace 'import z3' with 'from model_checker import z3_shim as z3', and replace direct 'z3.is_true(...)'/'z3.is_false(...)' calls with bare 'is_true(...)'/'is_false(...)' imported from model_checker.solver. bimodal and logos are the current-API reference pattern.
